items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s by Debussy, right? ... You had Debussy, Stravinsky, and those guys copying those guys.

ctx.x: It opened the door for Diva and so many of these other things. When I talk to Ellen Seeling and those people, they tell me, the first time they saw it was when they saw the Quincy Jones band and they saw Melba writing – what is it? Reverie. That she had done the arrangement on.
